description: This file defines Kivy UI components for an Accordion widget, including classes Accordion, AccordionItem, and AccordionException, with associated properties, methods, and a sample application demonstrating its usage.

classes.name: AccordionException
classes.description: Custom exception class for Accordion-related errors.

classes.name: AccordionItem
classes.description: Represents an individual item within an Accordion, with properties for title, background, collapse state, and methods for widget management and animation.

classes.name: Accordion
classes.description: Main Accordion widget class managing multiple AccordionItems, handling layout, selection, and orientation.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the Accordion or AccordionItem, with type checking for AccordionItem.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Selects a specific AccordionItem, collapsing others.

methods.name: _do_layout
methods.description: Performs layout calculations and positioning of AccordionItems based on orientation and space.

methods.name: _update_title
methods.description: Updates the title display of an AccordionItem.

methods.name: on_collapse
methods.description: Handles collapse state changes with animation.

methods.name: on_collapse_alpha
methods.description: Triggers layout update when collapse alpha changes.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch events for AccordionItem to toggle collapse.
